about.en: CUDIS is a wellness and longevity project built around the CUDIS smart ring, an AI health hub and an app that rewards users for health data and activity. CUDIS is its token, a BEP-20 on BNB Smart Chain at 0xC1353D3Ee02FDbd4f65F92EEe543cfd709049CB1, also issued on Solana at CudisfkgWvMKnZ3TWf6iCuHm8pN2ikXhDcWytwz6f6RN.
